cnaTypes: AI Researcher (Frontier AI Researcher CVE Numbering Authorities (CNAs) Pilot)
items.scope:
CNA Scope: Vulnerabilities in software, services, and open-source projects developed, maintained, or distributed by Anthropic. This includes Claude Code, Claude Desktop, browser extensions, the Model Context Protocol (MCP) SDKs and reference servers, Anthropic API client SDKs, and related developer tooling published under the Anthropic, anthropic-experimental, and modelcontextprotocol GitHub organizations.

Frontier AI Researcher CVE Numbering Authorities (CNAs) Pilot Scope: Vulnerabilities discovered by Anthropic that are not within another CNA’s scope.
Dell, Dell EMC, and VCE issues only.
All Bitdefender products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Bitdefender that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities discovered in the services and applications of the MeetMe and DuoxMe products that are not covered by another CNA’s scope.
Siemens issues only.
Supported Milestone XProtect products.

Vulnerabilities in Protect AI products, third-party code vulnerabilities reported by researchers collaborating with huntr and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Protect AI that are not in another CNA’s scope.
ASR products only.
Vulnerabilities discovered by or reported to cirosec researchers that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Pentraze Cybersecurity that are not in another CNA’s scope.
SailPoint issues only.
openGauss issues only.
EA issues only.
All HashiCorp products and projects unless covered by another CNA’s scope.
Pegasystems products only.

Products and technologies branded by Bull and its subsidiaries, unless covered by the scope of another CNA as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software and hardware discovered by Bull and its subsidiaries that are not in another CNA’s scope.

All IQSIGHT (formerly Bosch Building Technology - Video Systems) products including end-of-life products.
Vulnerabilities discovered by YesWeHack community hunters on products being tested on the platform with the permission of their owners, as part of Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure.
Vulnerabilities in software discovered by NCSC-FI, and vulnerabilities reported to NCSC-FI for coordinated disclosure, which are not in another CNA’s scope.
Concrete CMS Core versions 8.5 and above.
Vulnerabilities in Snyk products and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Snyk that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All currently supported PTC software products and cloud/SaaS services.
All products and services developed and/or sold by Panasonic Group companies.
All WatchDog products.
StrongDM issues only.
Vulnerabilities in vendor products discovered by BLSOPS, or related parties, while performing vulnerability research or security assessments, unless covered by another CNA’s scope.
Eaton issues only.

All products for Haverford Systems brands, PTZOptics and HuddleCamHD (supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products), as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Haverford Systems that are not in another CNA’s scope.
NVIDIA issues only.
All products of RT-Labs AB, excluding end-of-life-products; as well as vulnerabilities in third-party products used by RT-Labs AB that are not in the scope of another CNA.

All Acronis products, including Acronis Cyber Protect, Acronis Cyber Protect Home Office, Acronis DeviceLock DLP, and Acronis Snap Deploy.
